resources.string: Shares a link as an NFC tag
Ready. Hold the back of your phone against theirs.
NFC is off. Turn it on to share.
This phone cannot emulate an NFC tag.
Enter a full link, such as https://tbutman.com/hello
No NFC on their phone? They can scan this.
A tap opens the link below.

plurals.name: mode_contact_hint
plurals.item: A tap offers to save your contact card (name, title, email, %d phone number, links), then the link. The QR code holds the card too.
